cross_references.relationship: §56.10(c)(12) authorizes medical record disclosure to court investigators conducting §1826 conservatorship investigations
§56.10(c)(12) also authorizes disclosure for §1851 periodic reviews — ongoing access during conservatorship
CMIA implements the Art I §1 privacy right in the medical context — unauthorized medical disclosure is both a CMIA violation and a constitutional privacy violation
Bane Act may apply when medical information is weaponized through threats/intimidation/coercion to interfere with rights
If state actors (public hospital staff, county health workers, court investigators) violate CMIA, §1983 may reach the violation as a deprivation of the privacy right under color of state law
